avis.titre: Gentle Yet Effective, A New Skincare Favorite
avis.texte: I was honestly so excited to receive this, it really felt like such a thoughtful surprise! I've been curious about COSRX products for a while, so getting the chance to try the One Step Original Clear Skin Calming Pad before its launch made it even more special.After using it for a bit, I can say it's quickly become part of my routine. The pads are super convenient, especially on days when I want something quick but effective. They feel gentle on the skin, yet still do a great job of refreshing and lightly exfoliating. I've noticed my skin looks calmer, and areas that usually get irritated or break out seem more balanced.What I really like is that it doesn't feel harsh or drying. Instead, my skin feels clean, smooth, and hydrated after each use. It's the kind of product that fits easily into everyday skincare without any fuss.Overall, I'm really happy with this experience, both the surprise and the product itself. It's definitely something I'll keep using and recommend to anyone dealing with redness or occasional breakouts. Thank you again for including me, it truly made my day!
